title.en: Fable 6 — The Fisherman and the Little Fish

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: A fisherman caught a very small fish.
The fish asked: put me back in the water.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: אני אגדל ואז אהיה דג גדול.
sentences.en: He said: I will grow and then I will be a big fish.
The fisherman looked at him and thought.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: דג קטן ביד עדיף.
sentences.en: He said: a small fish in the hand is better.
What you have now is worth more.
